description: The modders' reference website (owner's decision D3, 23 Nov 2026; scripts/reference-site.py). projects: the source folders whose XML-facing types get an XML example and must carry a <summary>. categories: the kinds of XML-facing type, matched against each type's nearest base class by name, first match wins, so a narrower kind comes before a wider one. references: the NuGet packages DocFX compiles our source against (versions from Directory.Build.targets). knownGaps: XML-facing types without a <summary> when the check began, so the check blocks only new ones; take a name out when it gets its summary (check --write-baseline).

stamp.name: D'thorga Framework
stamp.why: every page's footer says when the site was built, from which version of this mod and which commit (owner, 28 Nov 2026)

downloads.why: the XML checker for other modders, bundled to one file with phobos-modkit's bundle command and published at the site's root (owner's card, 28 Nov 2026)

projectsLeftOut: Every mod with types a modder names in XML is here (owner, 28 Nov 2026: the Radio was missing). Left out: PhobosPatches.* (our patches of other authors' mods, with nothing to build on), the tie-in projects with no XML-facing types, and src/Shared (read by DocFX for the Framework, below).

addedInCode.why: Comps the mods add in code (the owner's card, 28 Nov 2026): their pages say so instead of offering XML to copy. never: true means writing it in XML is wrong; false keeps the example, for the cases its note names.

types.note: D'thorga Framework adds it at start-up to every powered building it can classify. To keep a building out, or take one in as a kind, use PhobosStandbyExtension.
D'thorga Framework adds it at start-up to every humanlike race, Humanoid Alien Races' included.
built from the vehicle's loadout, on every vehicle a loadout claims. Change what it holds with a loadout.
added to every vehicle with a loadout.
added to a vehicle whose loadout's avionics has countermeasures true.
added to a vehicle with the RemoteKitMount or RouteKitMount part role.
added to a vehicle with the RemoteKitMount part role.
added to a vehicle with the RouteKitMount part role.
added to a land vehicle with the RouteKitMount part role. Write it yourself only on a vehicle that has no such role.
added to a vehicle with CompProperties_PhobosFlight whose onlyInDrops is false.
added to a vehicle whose turrets, or whose upgrade tree's turrets, carry PhobosSmokeDischargerExtension.
added to every land vehicle with a loadout, trailers apart.
added to every vehicle with a loadout, trailers apart.
added to every VehicleBuildDef (a vehicle's frame), with a loadout or not.
added to every storage building (Building_Storage or a subclass), from every mod.
added to every land vehicle with a loadout, except a trailer and a loadout with noHitch. Write it yourself only on a trailer that should tow in turn.
added to every land vehicle with a loadout, and to a trailer whose CompProperties_PhobosTrailer has campDeck or campSide on.
added to a vehicle whose loadout has a sling block.
added to a vehicle whose loadout binds the Cabin part role.
added at start-up, with Dubs Bad Hygiene active and not in its lite mode, to every vehicle with a camp that is not a trailer.
added to every vehicle with our vehicle systems. What lets a vehicle pass calls on is a fitting that grants RadioCrossBand.

references.why: the game's reference assemblies; Microsoft.Extensions.* are left out because DocFX's own SDK brings a second copy of them, and the two clash

categories.name: Rules Defs
categories.where: One instance in your Defs; the first loaded wins, so patch its figures rather than adding a second.

categories.name: Vehicle system inputs
categories.where: In a vehicle system's `inputs` (a flow's, a derived quantity's), or any field that takes an input.

categories.name: Vehicle system conditions
categories.where: In a flow's or a rule's `when`, or as an `<li>` in a list of conditions (`When_All`, `When_Any`).

categories.name: Vehicle system effects
categories.where: In a stage's or an event's `effects`.

categories.name: Def extensions
categories.where: In any Def's `modExtensions`, or added to another mod's Def with PatchOperationAddModExtension.

categories.name: Defs
categories.where: A Def of its own in your Defs folder.
